cases.detail: 3 arrivals (2 names) -> 1 run, QC ran once
cases.doc: Same export dropped twice, then the same bytes under a new name: one run.

cases.detail: no run while writing; stalled half file held by checksum sidecar
cases.doc: A slow writer: no run until the file is complete. With a sidecar, even long pauses are safe.

cases.detail: v2 flagged 'supersedes v1', waited for its own approval
cases.doc: Approved plate re-exported with one well changed: new version, needs its own approval.

cases.detail: killed worker-418183; redelivered, resumed on attempt 2, one proposal
cases.doc: kill -9 the worker holding the run. RabbitMQ redelivers; the next worker takes over after the lease.

cases.detail: result committed, ack lost, redelivery ignored
cases.doc: Worker commits its result, then dies before acking. The redelivered message is a no-op.

cases.detail: 6 messages for one run -> 1 QC run, 5 no-ops
cases.doc: At-least-once delivery: the same run id published 5 extra times.

cases.detail: 9 plates (3 arrived while down) -> 9 runs, 9 proposals
cases.doc: RabbitMQ stops with unacked messages in flight, and files keep arriving while it is down.
Postgres restarts in the middle of a batch.

cases.detail: 60 files -> 50 runs, every plate once (6s, 4 workers)
cases.doc: 50 plates plus 10 duplicate re-syncs land at once.
Approve clicked 10 times at once (double clicks, two tabs, a retrying client).

cases.detail: re-drop linked to the rejected run; 0 rows; approve now 409
cases.doc: Rejected run; the same file is dropped again. It is linked, not run again.

cases.detail: retried write is a no-op; sweeper finished an orphaned approval
cases.doc: Rows commit but the writer never hears back, so it retries. Then the sweeper retries too.

cases.detail: 1 of 20 claims won (racer-15); the losers cannot write
cases.doc: 20 workers try to claim the same run at the same instant.

cases.detail: v1 result discarded, older late export kept for audit only; 1 approvable version
cases.doc: v2 arrives while v1 is still running; then an older export shows up late.

cases.detail: 2 bad files -> parked queue, 1 attempt each; good file still ran
cases.doc: A corrupt export goes to the parked queue once, and the workers keep going.

cases.detail: 12 runs rebuilt from 62 events, all match
cases.doc: Mixed workload, then rebuild every run's state from the append-only event log.
